ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the circuit diagram is the input voltage source Vsource, connected through the top series resistor Rseries = 470 Ω to the output node; this node is connected downward to ground through a Zener diode labeled Vz = 5.1 V, and on the right side there is also a load resistor Rload = 6 kΩ connected from the same node to ground. Therefore the Zener diode and the 6 kΩ load are in parallel, and both are supplied by the 470 Ω series resistor. Reasoning: Given Vsource = 10 V. If the Zener diode regulates voltage, then the output node voltage is 5.1 V. The series resistor current is Iseries = (10 - 5.1) / 470 = 0.0104255 A = 10.4255 mA. The load current is Iload = 5.1 / 6000 = 0.00085 A = 0.85 mA. The Zener current is Izener = Iseries - Iload = 10.4255 - 0.85 = 9.5755 mA, approximately 9.58 mA.

推理：题目给定 Vsource = 10 V。按指定方法，先暂时移除齐纳二极管，求从输出节点看进去的戴维南等效。开路节点电压由 470 Ω 与 6 kΩ 分压得到：Vth = 10 × 6000 / (470 + 6000) = 9.2736 V。戴维南电阻为 Rth = 470 || 6000 = 470×6000/(470+6000) = 435.86 Ω。因为 Vth = 9.2736 V 大于齐纳击穿电压 5.1 V，所以齐纳二极管进入击穿区并把输出节点钳位在约 5.1 V。于是齐纳电流为 Izener = (Vth − 5.1) / Rth = (9.2736 − 5.1) / 435.86 = 0.00958 A = 9.58 mA。
